'''Bella''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who held the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Private/Legends|private]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]], she was stationed on the [[Vaiken Spacedock]] in the Imperial Fleet, where she made her living as a vendor.

==Behind the scenes==
Bella first appeared in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' for Imperial classes. She can be found at the Imperial Fleet, and serves as a vendor.
